articles.title: England players carrying World Cup scar - Saka
articles.summary: England winger Bukayo Saka says the team are still carrying the "scar" of their heartbreaking World Cup semi-final exit to Argentina.

articles.title: The footballer who had a heart transplant - then became a World Cup winner
articles.summary: Martyn Jackson never thought he'd play football again when he had a heart transplant in 2024. Less than two years later, he was a World Cup winner with England.

articles.title: 'It can't be brushed over' - Republic of Ireland squad to discuss Israel games
articles.summary: Dara O'Shea says the Republic of Ireland squad will wait until after Thursday's Kosovo game before discussing how they approach Sunday's contentious fixture against Israel.

articles.title: Scots recall 'versatile' Kerr & Thomas for World Cup play-offs
articles.summary: Sam Kerr and Martha Thomas are named in their first Scotland squad in almost a year for next month's World Cup round one play-offs against the Czech Republic.

articles.title: Giants QB Dart ruled out for 2026 season with knee injury
articles.summary: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will miss the remainder of the 2026 NFL season due to a knee injury.
